Comment: CardDemo End-of-Day (EOD) Batch Pipeline state machine. Replaces the z/OS JCL business-processing chain per the AAP-mandated checkpoint contract (AAP §0.4.1 / §0.6.3): POSTTRAN -> INTCALC -> COMBTRAN -> Parallel { CREASTMT, TRANREPT }. Source JCL artifacts: app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl (CBTRN02C), app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl (CBACT04C with PARM='2022071800'), app/jcl/COMBTRAN.jcl (DFSORT + IDCAMS REPRO), app/jcl/CREASTMT.JCL (CBSTM03A text+HTML statements), app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl (CBTRN03C date-filtered transaction report). The README legacy batch sequence references app/jcl/TRANBKP.jcl (REPROC backup to TRANSACT.BKUP(+1)) between INTCALC and COMBTRAN, but the foundation-checkpoint scope explicitly excludes the TRANBKP Batch job definition and the corresponding ${TRANBKP_JOB_DEFINITION_ARN} substitution variable -- application-level transaction snapshots are now provided by RDS automated backups + point-in-time recovery (AAP §0.6.2) rather than an explicit application backup step; if a parallel-run snapshot capability is required at a later checkpoint it will be added as a separate state machine. Implements AAP §0.4.1 and §0.6.3 transformations: each Task uses arn:aws:states:::batch:submitJob.sync to invoke a Spring Batch job inside a Fargate container; the COBOL PARM date is passed via the INTEREST_CALC_PARM env var; Retry blocks model JCL COND= retry semantics; Catch blocks model JCL COND=(...,LT) skip-on-failure routing; SNS + CloudWatch metrics emit success/failure signals per AAP §0.6.6 observability requirements.

InitializeEodPipeline.Comment: Initialize EOD pipeline context with execution parameters. Aggregates Step Functions execution input (processingDate, secret ARNs, S3 bucket, KMS key, MSK bootstrap, SNS topic) into a single $.context object that downstream Task states reference via $.context.* JSONPath expressions. Replaces JCL: //POSTTRAN JOB statement, //NOTIFY=&SYSUID, and //JOBLIB JCLLIB ORDER= job-level metadata.

PostTransactions.Comment: Process daily transaction file and apply postings. Updates TRANSACT (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS), ACCTDATA (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS), and TCATBALF (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS); writes 4-stage rejects (XREF lookup, account lookup, credit limit, card expiration) to the DALYREJS S3 prefix. Replaces JCL: POSTTRAN.jcl STEP15 EXEC PGM=CBTRN02C with DDs STEPLIB, SYSPRINT, SYSOUT, TRANFILE, DALYTRAN, XREFFILE, DALYREJS (GDG +1), ACCTFILE, TCATBALF. COBOL program: CBTRN02C. Reject codes 100-109 preserved per AAP §0.4.1 TransactionPostingService entry.

CalculateInterest.Comment: Compute monthly interest and fees per disclosure-group rules with DEFAULT fallback. Writes system-generated interest transactions to the SYSTRAN S3 prefix (was AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.SYSTRAN(+1) GDG). Replaces JCL: INTCALC.jcl STEP15 EXEC PGM=CBACT04C,PARM='2022071800' with DDs STEPLIB, SYSPRINT, SYSOUT, TCATBALF, XREFFILE, XREFFIL1 (CARDXREF AIX PATH), ACCTFILE, DISCGRP, TRANSACT (SYSTRAN +1). COBOL program: CBACT04C. Per AAP §0.6.3 the original PARM='2022071800' literal is preserved as the INTEREST_CALC_PARM environment variable, sourced from $.context.processingDate at execution time.

CombineTransactions.Comment: Sort and combine TRANSACT.BKUP(0) and SYSTRAN(0) generations by transaction ID, then bulk-load the combined dataset back into TRANSACT. Pure utility job with no source COBOL program; Java target uses java.util.Comparator + bulk JPA insert per AAP §0.4.1 CombineTransactionsJob entry. Replaces JCL: COMBTRAN.jcl STEP05R EXEC PGM=SORT (DFSORT with SYMNAMES TRAN-ID,1,16,CH and SORT FIELDS=(TRAN-ID,A), concatenated SORTIN of TRANSACT.BKUP(0)+SYSTRAN(0), SORTOUT=TRANSACT.COMBINED(+1)) + STEP10 EXEC PGM=IDCAMS REPRO INFILE(TRANSACT.COMBINED) OUTFILE(TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS).

RunDownstreamReports.Comment: Fan out to CreateStatements (CBSTM03A text+HTML statements) and RunTransactionReports (CBTRN03C transaction report) in parallel branches. Both consume the post-COMBTRAN TRANSACT table independently — neither produces input for the other — so parallel execution is safe and matches AAP §0.6.3 Stage 4a/4b explicit guidance. Replaces JCL: independent execution of CREASTMT.JCL and TRANREPT.jcl after COMBTRAN in the original mainframe schedule.

CreateStatements.Comment: Generate text and HTML statements for every card in CARDXREF. Java target uses Template Method pattern for text/HTML variants per AAP §0.3.3. Output flows to S3 STMTFILE and HTMLFILE prefixes via S3OutputService per AAP §0.6.6 (was AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.STATEMNT.PS and AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.STATEMNT.HTML). Replaces JCL: CREASTMT.JCL DELDEF01 (IDCAMS DELETE/DEFINE CLUSTER prep — obviated by RDS schema management) + STEP010 EXEC PGM=SORT (re-key TRANSACT by TRAN-CARD-NUM,TRAN-ID to TRXFL.SEQ) + STEP020 EXEC PGM=IDCAMS,COND=(0,NE) (REPRO TRXFL.SEQ to TRXFL.VSAM.KSDS) + STEP030 EXEC PGM=IEFBR14,COND=(0,NE) (clean prior STMTFILE/HTMLFILE) + STEP040 EXEC PGM=CBSTM03A,COND=(0,NE) with DDs TRNXFILE, XREFFILE, ACCTFILE, CUSTFILE, STMTFILE, HTMLFILE. COBOL programs: CBSTM03A + CBSTM03B subroutine. The COND=(0,NE) skip-on-failure semantics are preserved via Step Functions Catch routing to the parent Parallel state.

RunTransactionReports.Comment: Generate the transaction report (date-window filter, sorted by card number) for the configured reporting window. Output written to S3 TRANREPT prefix (was AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANREPT(+1) GDG). Replaces JCL: TRANREPT.jcl STEP05R EXEC PROC=REPROC (FILEIN=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS, FILEOUT=AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP(+1)) + STEP05R EXEC PGM=SORT (SYMNAMES TRAN-CARD-NUM, TRAN-PROC-DT, PARM-START-DATE, PARM-END-DATE with SORT FIELDS=(TRAN-CARD-NUM,A) and INCLUDE COND=(TRAN-PROC-DT GE PARM-START-DATE AND TRAN-PROC-DT LE PARM-END-DATE)) + STEP10R EXEC PGM=CBTRN03C with DDs TRANFILE, CARDXREF, TRANTYPE, TRANCATG, DATEPARM, TRANREPT. COBOL program: CBTRN03C. The original inline SYMNAMES literals PARM-START-DATE,C'2022-01-01' and PARM-END-DATE,C'2022-07-06' are preserved as REPORT_START_DATE and REPORT_END_DATE env vars sourced from Step Functions execution input.

EmitSuccessMetric.Comment: Emit CloudWatch success metric on EOD pipeline completion under namespace CardDemo/EOD with dimensions StateMachine, ExecutionId, and ProcessingDate. Per AAP §0.6.6 observability requirements (CloudWatch + Container Insights + Micrometer bridge). Equivalent to the JCL job-end COND=0 signal that the mainframe operator console would display.

EodPipelineSucceeded.Comment: Terminal success state for the EOD pipeline. Equivalent to JCL job-end COND=0. CloudTrail records the execution for audit per AAP §0.6.6.

FailureNotification.Comment: Publish failure to SNS for operations team alerting. Subject and message include execution id, processing date, error type, and cause for triage. Replaces JCL: MSGCLASS=H + NOTIFY=&SYSUID job-end notification on abend, plus the implicit mainframe operator console abend message. Per AAP §0.6.3.

Parameters.Subject: CardDemo eod-batch-pipeline state machine FAILED
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Execution {} for processingDate {} failed. Error: {}. Cause: {}', $.context.executionId, $.context.processingDate, $.error.Error, $.error.Cause)

EmitFailureMetric.Comment: Emit CloudWatch failure metric under namespace CardDemo/EOD with dimensions StateMachine and ExecutionId, then transition to the terminal Fail state. Per AAP §0.6.6 observability requirements.

EodPipelineFailed.Comment: Terminal failure state. CloudTrail records the execution for audit per AAP §0.6.6. Operations team is alerted via the preceding FailureNotification SNS publish; CloudWatch records the EodPipelineFailed metric for dashboards and alarms.
EodPipelineFailed.Cause: One or more EOD pipeline steps failed. See execution history and SNS notification.
